notes: HubSpot delivers webhook payloads via POST to the connector's registered webhook URL; the URL is not templated.
The webhook payload includes dealId and property changes; dealstage may appear as internal ID (numeric) or label (string) depending on pipeline configuration.
Connector must extract deal.id and deal.stage from the payload for field mapping.
No authentication is required on the source webhook endpoint; HubSpot signs requests via X-HubSpot-Signature header (validation is connector responsibility).
Uses OAuth 2.0 token endpoint to exchange refresh_token for access_token.
Basic Auth header uses Base64-encoded client_id:client_secret; credentials stored in GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS env var.
Response includes access_token required for Google Sheets API calls.
If refresh token is expired or invalid, endpoint returns 400 error; connector must handle token refresh failure.
Requires Bearer token in Authorization header; token obtained from Google OAuth refresh step.
valueInputOption query parameter controls input interpretation (RAW, USER_ENTERED, etc.); mapped from deal.id per fieldMapping.
range uses A1 notation; target range provided via fieldMapping from deal.stage.
If sheet/table not found, values are appended to end of sheet.
Pagination not applicable; single append operation.
